title: Methamphetamine potentiates the use of outcome-specific associations via a hypothalamic-dopamine circuit
title_zh: 甲基苯丙胺通过下丘脑-多巴胺环路增强结果特异性联想
abstract: Drug cues strongly influence drug seeking and relapse to addiction. However, it is unclear how drug cues do this. We reveal that a novel pathway from ventral tegmental area dopamine (VTADA) neurons to the lateral hypothalamus (LH) is necessary and sufficient to govern learning about associations between cues and specific outcomes and the use of such associations to govern decision making. We found that prior methamphetamine self-administration enhanced the control that reward cues have over behavior in this same manner, which was correlated with bidirectional strengthening of the LH-VTA circuit. We characterized dopamine release in LH to reward cues across learning and found that this learning signal was augmented following methamphetamine experience. These data demonstrate that cues exert greater, specific control over decision making after repeated drug use, concomitant with drug-induced changes in the LH-VTA circuit. This contrasts with habit theories of addiction that assert behavior becomes automatic, without thought of possible outcomes.
abstract_zh: 药物相关线索强烈影响药物寻求行为和复吸。然而，这种作用机制尚不清楚。我们发现，一条来自腹侧被盖区（ventral tegmental area, VTA）多巴胺（DA）神经元到外侧下丘脑（lateral hypothalamus, LH）的新通路，对学习线索与特定结果之间的联想以及利用该类联想进行决策具有必要且充分的作用。我们发现，既往甲基苯丙胺自我给药会增强奖赏线索对行为的控制，并与LH-VTA环路的双向强化相关。我们在学习过程中描记了对奖励线索引起的LH多巴胺释放，发现该学习信号在甲基苯丙胺经验后被增强。结果表明，重复吸毒后线索对决策的控制更强且更特异，并与LH-VTA环路的药物诱导改变并存。这与传统成瘾“习惯”理论相反，后者认为行为在成瘾后会变得自动化，不再考虑可能结果。
